eyebrow.zh: 评测配置 · 可追溯运行

headline.zh:
先对齐评测设置，
再解释分数差异。
headline.en:
Declare the harness.
Then inspect the score.

sub.zh: HarnessProbe 用类型化 profile 保存提示词和解码设置，将同一算术题子集交给兼容端点，并生成比较矩阵、HTML 与运行材料。
sub.en: HarnessProbe stores prompts and decoding settings in typed profiles, runs a shared arithmetic subset through compatible endpoints, and produces comparison matrices, HTML and run artifacts.

caption.zh: 把评测设置写清，再比较结果
caption.en: Make evaluation settings explicit before comparing.

body.zh: 类型化字段保存提示词、stop 和解码参数。
body.en: Typed fields preserve prompts, stops and decoding settings.

body.zh: stub 标记让无凭据测试不能被误当成真实评测。
body.en: Stub markers distinguish credential-free testing from real evaluation.

body.zh: match --repro 可以保存当次 profile、prompt 与逐题输出。
body.en: match --repro can preserve the run’s profiles, prompts and per-problem output.

body.zh: v0.2.0 的 profile show / validate / probe 可在不发起完整评测的情况下检查、验证配置并探测端点。
body.en: The v0.2.0 profile show / validate / probe commands inspect and validate configuration and probe endpoints without a full run.

title.zh: 把评测设置写清，再比较结果
title.en: Make evaluation settings explicit before comparing.

body.zh: 比较两次评测时，模型名之外还需要知道 system prompt、stop、温度及输出限制。把这些设置显式保存，才方便复查结果差异来自哪里。工具读取已有声明，不会自动发现厂商未公开的 harness，也不保证内置参考分数是当前官方结果。
body.en: Comparing evaluations requires more than a model name: system prompts, stops, temperature and output limits matter. Explicit settings make differences easier to inspect. The tool reads declared profiles; it does not discover unpublished vendor harnesses or guarantee that bundled reference scores match current official results.

body.zh: 自带 YAML 声明 local-demo、64 token 上限、END stop 和空参考分数。真实 load_profile 成功解析；无 key 的 adapter 标为 stub；非法 reasoning_effort 被验证器拒绝。脚本没有调用 complete 或 run_match，因此没有模型分数。
body.en: The supplied YAML declares local-demo, a 64-token limit, END stop and no reference score. Real load_profile parsing succeeds, an adapter without a key is identified as stub, and invalid reasoning_effort is rejected. The script calls neither complete nor run_match, so it produces no model scores.

body.zh: profile.py 解析受控 YAML 子集并用 Pydantic 验证。runner 将题目格式化后调用 OpenAICompatAdapter，评分并保存逐题结果；matrix 聚合得分与声明参考分的差距；report 生成 HTML 和 ZIP。缺少 key 或端点时 adapter 会走确定性 stub，必须与真实推理分开。
body.en: profile.py parses a controlled YAML subset and validates it with Pydantic. runner formats problems, calls OpenAICompatAdapter and stores scored per-problem results. matrix aggregates scores and differences from declared reference scores; report writes HTML and ZIP. Without a key or endpoint, the adapter uses a deterministic stub that must be distinguished from real inference.

body.zh: HarnessProbe 用类型化 profile 保存提示词和解码设置，将同一算术题子集交给兼容端点，并生成比较矩阵、HTML 与运行材料。
body.en: HarnessProbe stores prompts and decoding settings in typed profiles, runs a shared arithmetic subset through compatible endpoints, and produces comparison matrices, HTML and run artifacts.

body.zh: 内置 profile 是声明的设置集合，不是自动逆向或官方配置认证。
body.en: Bundled profiles are declared settings, not automatic reverse-engineering or official configuration certification.

note.zh: v0.1.0 的真实离线配置预检，不是 benchmark。profile 中的 qwen 是 schema 允许的 vendor 标签，example-model 是构造模型标识，没有验证服务存在。
note.en: A real offline configuration preflight on v0.1.0, not a benchmark. qwen is an allowed schema label and example-model is a constructed identifier; no service availability is established.

body.zh: 自带 YAML 声明 local-demo、64 token 上限、END stop 和空参考分数。真实 load_profile 成功解析；无 key 的 adapter 标为 stub；非法 reasoning_effort 被验证器拒绝。脚本没有调用 complete 或 run_match，因此没有模型分数。
body.en: The supplied YAML declares local-demo, a 64-token limit, END stop and no reference score. Real load_profile parsing succeeds, an adapter without a key is identified as stub, and invalid reasoning_effort is rejected. The script calls neither complete nor run_match, so it produces no model scores.

body.zh: 需要 Python 3.12+。安装可能联网；先运行不发请求、不生成占位答案的配置示例。
body.en: Requires Python 3.12+. Installation may need network access; begin with the configuration example, which sends no requests and generates no stub answers.

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/harnessprobe.git
cd harnessprobe
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install -e .

harnessprobe profile show deepseek-v4
harnessprobe profile validate path/to/profile.yaml

limitations.zh: 内置 profile 是声明的设置集合，不是自动逆向或官方配置认证。
limitations.en: Bundled profiles are declared settings, not automatic reverse-engineering or official configuration certification.

limitations.zh: stub 分数、参考分数与 gap 均不能单独支持真实模型性能结论。
limitations.en: Stub scores, reference values and gaps alone do not establish real model performance.
